title: EC-Council CASE .NET
summary: EC-Council CASE .NET is a professional certification offered by EC-Council. This independent study guide covers all 9 course modules: Understanding Application Security, Threats, and Attacks, Security Requirements Gathering, Secure Application Design and Architecture, Secure Coding Practices for Input Validation, Secure Coding Practices for Authentication and Authorization, Secure Coding Practices for Cryptography, Secure Coding Practices for Session Management, Secure Coding Practices for Error Handling, Static and Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST & DAST). Every module has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam, written as realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each module the way the job asks for it.
objectives: Understanding Application Security, Threats, and Attacks
Secure Coding Practices for Input Validation
Secure Coding Practices for Authentication and Authorization
Secure Coding Practices for Session Management
Secure Coding Practices for Error Handling
Static and Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST & DAST)
attributionNote: EC-Council certification content is an independent study guide written for Cyber Pulse Academy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by EC-Council.
